name: d2r-match-making
description: Community matchmaking for Diablo II: Resurrected — PvP and leveling queues, live rooms, ranking, and a read-only desktop agent.

scripts.lint: turbo run lint && pnpm run lint:root
scripts.test: pnpm run test:harness && turbo run test
scripts.test:mutation:agent: mkdir -p reports/mutation && cargo mutants --manifest-path apps/agent/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --package d2rmm-agent-domain --output reports/mutation/agent-domain -- --lib && cargo mutants --manifest-path apps/agent/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --package d2rmm-agent-core --output reports/mutation/agent-core -- --lib && cargo mutants --manifest-path apps/agent/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --package d2rmm-agent-adapters --output reports/mutation/agent-adapters -- --lib
scripts.contracts:check: turbo run contracts:openapi && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/openapi.json packages/contracts/asyncapi.json packages/contracts/json-schema/
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run arch && pnpm run test && pnpm run specs:check && pnpm run quality:gate
scripts.quality:gate: pnpm run quality:reports && node scripts/quality-collect.mjs && node scripts/quality-ratchet.mjs --context pr --current reports/quality.json
